title: Offline wind-down moves
description: Small things to do after putting the phone down.
author: claude

moves.text: Read 5 pages of a book.
Lay out tomorrow's clothes.
Take 10 slow breaths by the window.
Tidy the desk for 5 minutes.
Write tomorrow's first step on paper.
Stretch your neck and shoulders for 3 minutes.
Read a poem aloud.
Fill a water bottle for the morning.
Sit quietly for 10 minutes.
Clear the bedside table.
Write down one good moment from today.
Roll your shoulders slowly for 2 minutes.
Read one short chapter.
Put a book by the bed for tomorrow.
Listen to the evening sounds for 5 minutes.
Fold the loose clothes in your room.
List three things to take with you tomorrow.
Walk slowly around the room for 3 minutes.
Reread a favorite paragraph.
Plug the phone in away from the bed.
Look out the window for 5 quiet minutes.
Put away a few clean dishes.
Write 3 lines about something you read.
Loosen your hands and wrists for 2 minutes.
